task: Phase 2 Task 4 - Oracle and Future Information Audit

oracle_evaluation.selection_method: Select prediction sample with minimum future-ground-truth ADE
oracle_evaluation.fde_selection: FDE from the same sample selected by minimum ADE
oracle_evaluation.interpretation: Best-of-five oracle metrics, not single-sample deployment metrics

future_pedestrian_information.interpretation: Future pedestrian presence is available during prediction rollout

future_vehicle_information.interpretation: Method 4 uses future vehicle information during prediction rollout

metric_mask_distinction: Future pedestrian presence used only for evaluation masking would not alone establish model-input leakage. This implementation also uses future pedestrian information inside the rollout.
